ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin/Agenda Safe-Mode reboot pivot: bcdedit safeboot toggle paired with recovery wipe
ucs.description: Hunts Qilin's signature pre-encryption move — flipping the host to Safe Mode / Safe Mode with Networking via bcdedit so the Rust/Go ransomware binary runs without EDR loaded, immediately followed by VSS / wbadmin / boot-recovery wiping. The bcdedit-safeboot + recovery-disable pairing within a one-hour window is a Qilin (Agenda) hallmark documented by Trend Micro and Sophos X-Ops on the Qilin.B variant.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.process_name) as tools values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where ((Processes.process_name=bcdedit.exe AND (Processes.process="*safeboot*" OR Processes.process="*recoveryenabled no*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures*")) OR (Processes.process_name=vssadmin.exe AND Processes.process="*delete*" AND Processes.process="*shadow*") OR (Processes.process_name=wbadmin.exe AND Processes.process="*delete catalog*") OR (Processes.process_name=wmic.exe AND Processes.process="*shadowcopy delete*")) by host Processes.user _time span=1h | where mvcount(tools)>=2 AND match(mvjoin(tools,","),"bcdedit\.exe") | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename user as src_user | eval signal="Qilin safe-mode + recovery wipe" | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let lookback = 7d;
let Safeboot = DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
| where FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("safeboot","recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("mmc.exe","msconfig.exe")
| project SafebootTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, SafebootCmd = ProcessCommandLine, Parent = InitiatingProcessFileName, ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let RecoveryWipe = DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
| where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadow")
     or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete catalog")
     or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy delete")
     or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"))
| project DeviceId, RecoveryTime = Timestamp, RecoveryCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
Safeboot
| join kind=inner RecoveryWipe on DeviceId
| where RecoveryTime between (SafebootTime - 1h .. SafebootTime + 1h)
| where AccountName !endswith "$" and AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| summarize SafebootCmds = make_set(SafebootCmd), RecoveryCmds = make_set(RecoveryCmd), FirstSafeboot = min(SafebootTime), LastRecovery = max(RecoveryTime) by DeviceName, AccountName, Parent, ParentCmd
| order by FirstSafeboot desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let lookback = 7d;
let Safeboot = SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName endswith @"\bcdedit.exe"
| where CommandLine has_any ("safeboot","recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures")
| where ParentProcessName !endswith @"\mmc.exe" and ParentProcessName !endswith @"\msconfig.exe"
| project SafebootTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, SafebootCmd = CommandLine, ParentProcessName;
let RecoveryWipe = SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where EventID == 4688
| where (NewProcessName endswith @"\vssadmin.exe" and CommandLine has "delete" and CommandLine has "shadow")
     or (NewProcessName endswith @"\wbadmin.exe" and CommandLine has "delete catalog")
     or (NewProcessName endswith @"\wmic.exe" and CommandLine has "shadowcopy delete")
     or (NewProcessName endswith @"\bcdedit.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"))
| project Computer, RecoveryTime = TimeGenerated, RecoveryCmd = CommandLine;
Safeboot
| join kind=inner RecoveryWipe on Computer
| where RecoveryTime between (SafebootTime - 1h .. SafebootTime + 1h)
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$" and SubjectUserName !in~ ("SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE")
| summarize SafebootCmds = make_set(SafebootCmd), RecoveryCmds = make_set(RecoveryCmd), FirstSafeboot = min(SafebootTime) by Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName
| order by FirstSafeboot desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Qilin/Agenda Ransomware Safe Mode Boot Configuration via bcdedit
id: 7f6a1c2e-9b3a-4f1a-bd6c-8f3d2a4c1e88
status: experimental
description: Detects bcdedit being used to configure safeboot or disable boot recovery, a signature Qilin/Agenda ransomware behaviour where victims are rebooted into Safe Mode to bypass loaded EDR before encryption.
references:
  - https://news.sophos.com/en-us/2024/10/23/qilin-ransomware-deploys-fortified-version-with-rust-and-amsi-bypass/
  - https://www.trendmicro.com/en_us/research/24/h/agenda-ransomware-qilin.html
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/19
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1562.009
  - attack.t1490
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\bcdedit.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'safeboot'
      - 'recoveryenabled no'
      - 'bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures'
  filter_admin_tools:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\mmc.exe'
      - '\msconfig.exe'
      - '\SystemPropertiesAdvanced.exe'
  condition: selection_img and selection_cmd and not filter_admin_tools
falsepositives:
  - Manual recovery operations by IT staff via console
  - Imaging / OSD scripts during build
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.security @EventID:4688 @Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEdit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) @CommandLine:(*safeboot* OR *SAFEBOOT* OR *"recoveryenabled no"* OR *"bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"*) -@ParentImage:(*\\mmc.exe OR *\\MMC.EXE OR *\\msconfig.exe OR *\\MSConfig.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i
| regex("safeboot|recoveryenabled\\s+no|bootstatuspolicy\\s+ignoreallfailures", field=CommandLine)
| NOT ParentBaseFileName=/^(mmc|msconfig|SystemPropertiesAdvanced)\.exe$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName], function={ collect([CommandLine, ImageFileName]) | count(as=hits) })
| sort(field=hits, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: Qilin/Agenda (Russian-speaking RaaS, active since mid-2022) is one of the very few crews that consistently reboots victims into Safe Mode to defeat EDR — this was hard-coded in Qilin.B Rust builds documented by Sophos X-Ops and Trend Micro. Generic ransomware crews settle for vssadmin delete; Qilin's combination of bcdedit safeboot + recoveryenabled-no + shadow wipe in a sub-hour window is rare el

ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin (Agenda) pre-encryption: Defender impairment via PowerShell paired with mass backup/DB service kill
ucs.description: Hunts Qilin operators' staging pattern — a single host issues PowerShell Set-MpPreference / Add-MpPreference to disable real-time monitoring and add ransomware-folder exclusions, then within ~30 minutes stops Veeam / MSSQL / Exchange / BackupExec services from the same logon session. This dual-prong is straight out of the Agenda Rust playbook and is the loudest in-the-wild Qilin pre-deploy.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.process_name) as tools from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where ((Processes.process_name IN (powershell.exe,pwsh.exe) AND (Processes.process="*Set-MpPreference*Disable*" OR Processes.process="*Add-MpPreference*Exclusion*" OR Processes.process="*DisableRealtimeMonitoring*" OR Processes.process="*DisableBehaviorMonitoring*" OR Processes.process="*Uninstall-WindowsFeature*Windows-Defender*")) OR (Processes.process_name IN (sc.exe,net.exe,taskkill.exe,powershell.exe,pwsh.exe) AND (Processes.process="*VeeamBackupSvc*" OR Processes.process="*VeeamDeploymentService*" OR Processes.process="*VeeamTransportSvc*" OR Processes.process="*MSSQLSERVER*" OR Processes.process="*SQLAgent*" OR Processes.process="*SQLWriter*" OR Processes.process="*MSExchange*" OR Processes.process="*BackupExec*" OR Processes.process="*Acronis*" OR Processes.process="*CommVault*" OR Processes.process="*Veritas*" OR Processes.process="*NetBackup*"))) by host Processes.user _time span=30m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eval has_defender=if(match(mvjoin(cmdlines,"|"),"(?i)mppreference|defender"),1,0), has_killsvc=if(match(mvjoin(cmdlines,"|"),"(?i)veeam|mssql|exchange|backupexec|acronis|commvault|veritas|netbackup"),1,0) | where has_defender=1 AND has_killsvc=1 | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let lookback = 7d;
let DefenderOff = DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (
    "Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring",
    "Set-MpPreference -DisableBehaviorMonitoring",
    "Set-MpPreference -DisableScriptScanning",
    "Set-MpPreference -DisableIOAVProtection",
    "Add-MpPreference -ExclusionPath",
    "Add-MpPreference -ExclusionExtension",
    "Uninstall-WindowsFeature -Name Windows-Defender")
| project DefenderTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, LogonId, DefenderCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
let BackupKill = DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
| where FileName in~ ("sc.exe","net.exe","taskkill.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","net1.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (
    "VeeamBackupSvc","VeeamDeploymentService","VeeamNFSSvc","VeeamTransportSvc",
    "MSSQLSERVER","SQLAgent","SQLWriter","MSExchange",
    "BackupExec","Acronis","CommVault","Veritas","NetBackup",
    "VSS","vmms","MSDTC")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("stop","kill","/F ","Stop-Service")
| project DeviceId, KillTime = Timestamp, KillCmd = ProcessCommandLine, KillTool = FileName, LogonId;
DefenderOff
| join kind=inner BackupKill on DeviceId
| where KillTime between (DefenderTime - 30m .. DefenderTime + 1h)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| summarize DefenderCmds = make_set(DefenderCmd), KillCmds = make_set(KillCmd), KillTools = make_set(KillTool), FirstDefender = min(DefenderTime), LastKill = max(KillTime), KillCount = dcount(KillCmd) by DeviceName, AccountName
| where KillCount >= 2
| order by FirstDefender desc
